+import { searchClient } from '@algolia/client-search'
+import type { SearchOptions, SearchResponse } from './types'
+
+// From Algolia example
+// https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch
+const ALGOLIA_APP_ID = 'latency'
+const ALGOLIA_SEARCH_API_KEY = '6be0576ff61c053d5f9a3225e2a90f76'
+
+export const productsAPI = {
+  searchProducts: async <TData>({
+    indexName,
+    query,
+    pageParam,
+    hitsPerPage = 10,
+  }: SearchOptions): Promise<SearchResponse<TData>> => {
+    const client = searchClient(ALGOLIA_APP_ID, ALGOLIA_SEARCH_API_KEY)
+
+    console.log('algolia:search', { indexName, query, pageParam, hitsPerPage })
+
+    const { hits, nbPages = 0 } = await client.searchSingleIndex<TData>({
+      indexName,
+      searchParams: { query, page: pageParam, hitsPerPage },
+    })
+
+    return { hits, nbPages }
+  },
+}

+import { infiniteQueryOptions, skipToken } from '@tanstack/vue-query'
+import { productsAPI } from './api'
+import type { SearchOptions } from './types'
+
+export const productsQueries = {
+  all: () => ['products'] as const,
+  search: <TData>({
+    indexName,
+    query,
+    hitsPerPage,
+  }: Omit<SearchOptions, 'pageParam'>) =>
+    infiniteQueryOptions({
+      queryKey: [
+        ...productsQueries.all(),
+        'search',
+        indexName,
+        query,
+        hitsPerPage,
+      ] as const,
+      queryFn: query
+        ? ({ pageParam }) =>
+            productsAPI.searchProducts<TData>({
+              indexName,
+              query,
+              pageParam,
+              hitsPerPage,
+            })
+        : skipToken,
+      initialPageParam: 0,
+      getNextPageParam: (lastPage, _allPages, lastPageParam) =>
+        lastPageParam + 1 < lastPage.nbPages ? lastPageParam + 1 : undefined,
+    }),
+}

+import { createApp } from 'vue'
+import { VueQueryPlugin } from '@tanstack/vue-query'
+
+import App from './App.vue'
+import type { QueryKey } from '@tanstack/vue-query'
+
+// Define a default query function that will receive the query key
+const defaultQueryFn = async ({ queryKey }: { queryKey: QueryKey }) => {
+  const response = await fetch(
+    `https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com${queryKey[0]}`,
+  )
+  if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch data')
+  return await response.json()
+}
+
+createApp(App)
+  // provide the default query function to your app via the query client
+  .use(VueQueryPlugin, {
+    queryClientConfig: {
+      defaultOptions: {
+        queries: {
+          queryFn: defaultQueryFn,
+        },
+      },
+    },
+  })
+  .mount('#app')

+import type { Todo, Todos } from './types'
+
+let nextId = 0
+let list = [
+  'apple',
+  'banana',
+  'pineapple',
+  'grapefruit',
+  'dragonfruit',
+  'grapes',
+].map((d) => ({ id: nextId++, name: d, notes: 'These are some notes' }))
+
+export const serverConfig = {
+  errorRate: 0.05,
+  queryTimeMin: 1000,
+  queryTimeMax: 2000,
+}
+
+export const todosAPI = {
+  getTodos: ({
+    filter,
+    signal,
+  }: {
+    filter: string
+    signal: AbortSignal
+  }): Promise<Todos> => {
+    console.info('getTodos', { filter })
+
+    signal.addEventListener('abort', () => {
+      console.info('cancelled', filter)
+    })
+
+    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+      setTimeout(
+        () => {
+          if (Math.random() < serverConfig.errorRate) {
+            return reject(
+              new Error(JSON.stringify({ getTodos: { filter } }, null, 2)),
+            )
+          }
+          resolve(list.filter((d) => d.name.includes(filter)))
+        },
+        serverConfig.queryTimeMin +
+          Math.random() *
+            (serverConfig.queryTimeMax - serverConfig.queryTimeMin),
+      )
+    })
+  },
+  getTodo: ({ id }: { id: number }): Promise<Todo> => {
+    console.info('getTodo', { id })
+    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+      setTimeout(
+        () => {
+          if (Math.random() < serverConfig.errorRate) {
+            return reject(
+              new Error(JSON.stringify({ getTodo: { id } }, null, 2)),
+            )
+          }
+          const todo = list.find((d) => d.id === id)
+          if (!todo) {
+            return reject(new Error(`Todo with id ${id} not found`))
+          }
+          resolve(todo)
+        },
+        serverConfig.queryTimeMin +
+          Math.random() *
+            (serverConfig.queryTimeMax - serverConfig.queryTimeMin),
+      )
+    })
+  },
+  createTodo: ({ name, notes }: Omit<Todo, 'id'>): Promise<Todo> => {
+    console.info('createTodo', { name, notes })
+    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+      setTimeout(
+        () => {
+          if (Math.random() < serverConfig.errorRate) {
+            return reject(
+              new Error(
+                JSON.stringify({ createTodo: { name, notes } }, null, 2),
+              ),
+            )
+          }
+          const todo = { name, notes, id: nextId++ }
+          list = [...list, todo]
+          resolve(todo)
+        },
+        serverConfig.queryTimeMin +
+          Math.random() *
+            (serverConfig.queryTimeMax - serverConfig.queryTimeMin),
+      )
+    })
+  },
+  updateTodo: (todo: Todo): Promise<Todo> => {
+    console.info('updateTodo', todo)
+    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+      setTimeout(
+        () => {
+          if (Math.random() < serverConfig.errorRate) {
+            return reject(
+              new Error(JSON.stringify({ updateTodo: todo }, null, 2)),
+            )
+          }
+          list = list.map((d) => {
+            if (d.id === todo.id) {
+              return todo
+            }
+            return d
+          })
+          resolve(todo)
+        },
+        serverConfig.queryTimeMin +
+          Math.random() *
+            (serverConfig.queryTimeMax - serverConfig.queryTimeMin),
+      )
+    })
+  },
+}

+import { mutationOptions, queryOptions } from '@tanstack/vue-query'
+import { todosAPI } from './api'
+
+export const todosQueries = {
+  all: () => ['todos'] as const,
+  lists: () => [...todosQueries.all(), 'list'] as const,
+  list: (filter: string) =>
+    queryOptions({
+      queryKey: [...todosQueries.lists(), { filter }] as const,
+      queryFn: ({ signal }) => todosAPI.getTodos({ filter, signal }),
+    }),
+  detail: (id: number) =>
+    queryOptions({
+      queryKey: [...todosQueries.all(), 'detail', id] as const,
+      queryFn: () => todosAPI.getTodo({ id }),
+    }),
+}
+
+export const todosMutations = {
+  create: () =>
+    mutationOptions({
+      mutationFn: todosAPI.createTodo,
+    }),
+  update: () =>
+    mutationOptions({
+      mutationFn: todosAPI.updateTodo,
+    }),
+}
